*   **Input:** A planet-wide voxel dataset; camera position and orientation; frame time budget (GPU/CPU availability) [S2, unofficial].

The claim lists four specific inputs: a planet-wide voxel dataset, camera position and orientation, frame time budget, and GPU/CPU availability. The evidence explicitly confirms all these elements: 1) It describes a 'planet-wide octree of chunk trees' (planet-wide voxel dataset). 2) It mentions a 'screen-space cut of the octree that follows the eye position' and 'camera dropping from orbit' (camera position and orientation). 3) It states generation happens 'within the frame's budget' (frame time budget). 4) It specifies the budget 'adapts to both GPU and CPU availability' (GPU/CPU availability).
